title: Grade distribution
statementMd:
How many graded enrollments earned each letter grade (A 90+, B 80+, C 70+, D 60+, otherwise F)?

Expected columns: `letter`, `n`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'B' WHEN score >= 70 THEN 'C' WHEN score >= 60 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END AS letter, COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments WHERE score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY letter;
```
